history.title: Our story
history.description: Our story begins when destiny gave us an unexpected turn. As a result of the pandemic, life took us from sprawling Mexico City to the paradise of the Riviera Maya. Venturing into tourism and hospitality, we understood that modern tourism had become cold and automated. That's why we decided to go against the current: to offer more human, friendly and personal service in an increasingly digital world. We firmly believe that a robot cannot hear your dreams or understand what makes a trip special. We realized that the industry had become cold. But we believe that a robot can never replace the embrace of a good host. We are the result of the union of two cultures: the DUTCH structure and the unmatched MEXICAN warmth. This fusion allowed us to build a proudly 100% MEXICAN company.
history.missionP1: To create and operate extraordinary travel experiences in the Riviera Maya, designed to exceed the expectations of every traveler, whether on individual, family or group adventures.
history.missionP2: Our mission is to offer peace of mind, trust and personalized attention at every stage of the journey, caring for every detail with professionalism and passion so that our clients only have to worry about enjoying themselves. We are committed to turning every experience into an unforgettable memory, delivering excellent service that reflects the natural, cultural and human richness of the Mexican Caribbean.
history.visionP1: To be the leading integrator of tourism services in the Mexican Caribbean, recognized nationally and internationally for delivering the highest quality experiences, where the efficiency, organization and excellence of European standards blend with the warmth, hospitality and authenticity of Mexican service.
history.visionP2: We aspire to become the trusted partner of travelers from around the world, standing out for the innovation, commitment and passion with which we design every experience, positioning ourselves as the most reliable choice for discovering and living the magic of Mexico.

culture.title: Cultural connection
culture.p1: We believe that traveling goes far beyond seeing a destination; it is about building an authentic bond with its history, its people and its traditions. That is why we promote a true connection with the cultural richness of Mexico, bringing every traveler closer to the extraordinary legacy of the Maya civilization, the majesty of nature and the experiences that make this destination unique.
culture.p2: Every journey is designed to inspire, stir emotions and turn each trip into an enriching cultural experience, where respect, learning and admiration for our roots stay in the hearts of those who visit us.

trust.title: Safety and trust
trust.p1: Your peace of mind is our highest priority. From the first contact to the end of your trip, we are by your side with personalized attention, expert advice and constant assistance so you can enjoy every moment with complete confidence.
trust.p2: Our commitment is to provide reliable, professional and transparent service, backed by a team passionate about creating memorable experiences. More than organizing a trip, we become your partner and guide, making sure every detail is carefully planned so you can simply enjoy.

hospitality.title: Hospitality
hospitality.p1: The essence of Mexico lies in the warmth of its people. We are a country that welcomes the world with open arms, and that hospitality is at the heart of every experience we offer.
hospitality.p2: We are committed to sharing authentic Mexican quality and warmth, inviting you to discover destinations full of history, culture, gastronomy, art and traditions that awaken all the senses. We want every visitor to feel at home and every trip to leave memories so special that there is always a reason to come back.
hospitality.p3: Because traveling with us is experiencing Mexico from its most authentic, human and unforgettable side.

q1.question: What is the best time to visit the Riviera Maya?
q1.answer: The best time is from November to April, when the weather is dry and temperatures are pleasant. However, the region offers unique experiences throughout the year.

q2.question: Do you include transportation from the airport?
q2.answer: Yes, we have airport-hotel transportation service in all our options: shared, private, luxury and bus.

q3.question: Can I book tours for large groups?
q3.answer: Absolutely! We have experience organizing events for large groups, conventions and company trips. Contact us for a personalized quote.

q4.question: What is the cancellation policy?
q4.answer: Our cancellation policy varies by service. Generally, you can cancel free of charge up to 48 hours in advance. We recommend checking the specific terms at the time of booking.

q5.question: Do you offer travel insurance?
q5.answer: Yes, we can help you purchase travel insurance that covers your stay. Ask us about the available options.

hero.title: GROUPS & CONVENTIONS
hero.subtitle: We know that every group is different, with its own planning and objectives.
hero.text:
We focus on creating memorable group experiences, with a coordination structure suited to each group's needs. Don't worry about large-scale logistics: we have extensive experience in group management and handling!

At Tropical Vitamin we coordinate the entire planning, organization, control, management, production and logistics of the entire group at the destination, through to their departure and the close of your event.
Relax, leave it in our hands!

groups.miceDesc: Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions: We are your eyes in the destination! Rely on the experts to start the search from the venue to all the coordination and management you need for your event.
groups.teamDesc: Creative corporate experiences with a defined objective: strengthening your team.
groups.bodaDesc: Count on us for the logistics of your event without worrying about anything or anyone, and enjoy the best moment of your life with the one you love.
groups.viajerosDesc: There is no better vitamin for the soul than the memories of adventures. Let us show you the side of the Riviera Maya that you don't know.
groups.familiaDesc: "Láak'tsilil" means family in Maya. Reconnect in a paradise full of vegetation and unforgettable experiences.
groups.escolaresDesc: Live one of the best stages of your life in the company of your best friends. We guarantee it will be part of stories they will have to tell over and over again.
groups.deportivosDesc: We help you carry out your tournaments and manage your team or the attending teams for sports coordination.

trips.cumpleanosDesc: Celebrate your life and celebrate with your loved ones! We organize all the details you deserve for your day and celebration.
